data: What is the maximum average score on all GLUE tasks for models trained on MLM?

The question asks for the maximum average score on all GLUE tasks for models trained on MLM. From the caption, we know that the figure shows the average results for three different models: MLM, NSP, and Split, across three categories of tasks: all GLUE tasks, inference tasks, and non-inference tasks. The relevant subfigure is the one labeled 'a) All tasks'. 

Looking at the graph, the blue line represents the MLM model. The highest point on this line corresponds to the maximum average score on all GLUE tasks for models trained on MLM. By visually inspecting the graph, the maximum value appears to be around 79. Therefore, the maximum average score on all GLUE tasks for models trained on MLM is approximately 79.
